title: Uruguayan Yuzu Empanadas
description: Savory empanadas filled with a tangy yuzu and beef mixture, perfect for a lazy Sunday morning.

ingredients.name: yuzu juice
ingredients.notes: see notes on yuzu juice quantity for fermenting dough

instructions: Combine flour, yuzu zest, salt, and black pepper in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add water while mixing dough with a wooden spoon until a shaggy ball forms.
Knead dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in an oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 24-48 hours.
Punch down dough and divide into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Mix beef, onion, garlic, fennel, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of beef mixture in the center of each dough circle, brush edges with egg, and fold dough over filling, pressing edges to seal.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, add empanadas seam-side down, and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer empanadas to a baking sheet and bake in a preheated oven at 400°F (200°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let empanadas cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional yuzu zest if desired.
Freeze leftovers for up to 2 months.
